title: Install GlusterFS on Rocky Linux 10 (rolling)
summary: A step-by-step install tutorial for Rocky Linux 10. Use the rolling Eliware repository, verify package and service state at every checkpoint, and replace angle-bracket placeholders with values from your environment.

steps.title: Prepare the host
steps.text: Update the host and install EPEL for supplemental Enterprise Linux dependencies. GlusterFS itself comes from the signed Eliware repository.
commands: sudo dnf install -y epel-release dnf-plugins-core ca-certificates
steps.verify: dnf completes without repository or signature errors.

steps.title: Enable the Eliware source
steps.text: Import the signing key and add the EL10 repository. Rolling is opt-in and intended for evaluation.
steps.verify: rpm and dnf show a trusted Eliware repository.

steps.title: Install GlusterFS
steps.text: Install server and client packages. Add RDMA packages only when using InfiniBand.
steps.verify: The version and package signatures are correct.

steps.title: Start glusterd
steps.text: Enable the management daemon at boot and start it.

steps.title: Validate the node
steps.text: Check identity, time, storage mounts, and firewall policy. Bricks must use node-local storage with extended attributes.
commands: sudo firewall-cmd --list-all 2>/dev/null || sudo ufw status verbose
steps.verify: Name resolution, time, storage, and firewall policy are intentional.

steps.title: Build the trusted pool
steps.text: From one trusted node, probe each new node and verify the pool.

steps.title: Create and test a replica-3 volume
steps.text: Prepare one local brick directory on every node, create and start the volume, then test a client mount.
steps.verify: The volume is Started and the test file is visible through the mount.
